aircraft._commentFlaps: No generic flap detents: X-Plane fallback should use physical flap angle or raw deploy ratio until a specific profile supplies source-backed detents.

stability._comment: Broad fallback bands avoid aircraft-specific stability claims when no matching profile is available.

speedBand._comment: Broad fallback band; an aircraft-specific profile is required for limit-based assessment.

vsLimits._comment: Broad fallback vertical-speed band pending aircraft-specific limits.

pitch._comment: Broad fallback pitch band pending aircraft-specific limits.

landing._comment: Broad fallback landing bands are used when aircraft-specific thresholds are unavailable.

grades._comment: Aircraft-specific profiles should replace these generic landing bands.

phaseThresholds._comment: Generic phase thresholds; aircraft-specific profiles may override them.

spoilers._comment: Generic linear scale: 0-16383 linear, no armed detection. Armed state requires aircraft-specific LVAR.

meta.notes: Generic fallback profile for X-Plane. Shares permissive aircraft semantics with the MSFS generic profile, but is keyed and distributed separately to avoid simulator collisions.
